title: HUANUO FlowLift™ Pro Monitor Arm for 13–32" Screens, MechaSpring Monitor Mount, Fully-Adjustable Monitor Stand with Tilt/Swivel/Rotation, Tool-Free VESA Mount, C-Clamp/Grommet Base, Max Load 19.8 lbs
features: Check Desk & Monitor Compatibility: To ensure a proper fit, your monitor must meet the following 3 conditions at the same time: First, screen size ranges from 13" to 32". Second, your monitor must weigh between 4.4 and 19.8 lbs. Third, it must support VESA patterns of 75×75mm or 100×100mm. Meanwhile, we recommend mounting this monitor arm only on wood desks 0.59"– 3.54" thick (other desk types are not recommended). Note: If your desk has irregular edges, please choose this monitor arm carefully.

MechaSpring Arm — Built for 2× Longer Life: Featuring the MechaSpring arm, this VESA monitor mount delivers consistent support over time for dependable performance that lasts. Unlike gas-based designs that may lose pressure, this monitor desk mount helps keep your monitor steady through everyday adjustments, offering up to 2× the service life of conventional mounts. Moreover, with 90% professional-grade metal construction, the single monitor arm delivers strong reliability, day after day.

LockSteady System — Adjust with Ease, Hold with Strength: With the upgraded system, the monitor mount helps resist screen droop and moves smoothly with just one finger if you adjust screens often. For set-and-forget setups or deep focus work—like designing, coding and data analysis—where the monitor stays in place most of the time, it holds steady right where you leave it for reliable viewing. This monitor stand is also TÜV Rheinland certified and tested at 3x its load for added safety.

ACA-Endorsed Design for Ergonomic Comfort — Backed by the American Chiropractic Association (ACA), the desk monitor mount helps reduce neck & back strain by raising your monitor to eye level and fine-tuning it. It transitions smoothly between focused coding, intense gaming and screen sharing during meetings, creating a more comfortable setup for both work and play. Not only does it transform your desk into a professional workstation, but it also supports your health as much as your productivity.

PrecisionView Window — Tension Adjustment Made Visible: Stop guessing. Start seeing. Unlike a traditional monitor mount where tension is adjusted by feel alone, our integrated PrecisionView window provides instant visual feedback through the yellow indicator movement. You'll know exactly when the tension is perfectly calibrated for your monitor's weight — no more over-tightening or endless trial and error. This professional-grade precision puts you in full control from the first turn.

Tool-Free InstaMount VESA Plate — Snap-In Setup in Seconds: Experience the fastest monitor arm assembly on the market. Thanks to the quick-release VESA plate, you simply snap your monitor into place with a secure click — no more struggling to align screws while holding a heavy screen. With the simplified main parts (1 base, 1 screw), you'll go from box to brilliant in minutes. The frustration-free installation is designed for everyone — helping you create a minimalist desk and hide messy wires.
